# kion_project_note (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Kion Project Notes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_project_note" "example" {
  # Required
  id         = "example"
  project_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the project note to look up.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the note belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `create_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who created the note.
- `create_user_name` (String) Name of the user who created the note.
- `last_update_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who last updated the note.
- `last_update_user_name` (String) Name of the user who last updated the note.
- `name` (String) Name of the project note.
- `text` (String) Body text of the project note.
